summary: Iteration 3 (resilience / no-blank-page fixes) verified end-to-end. Backend regression: 31/31 pytest cases pass (iter1 + iter2 suites via /app/backend/tests). All critical endpoints return 200 (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/dashboard/stats, /api/bills, /api/bills/{id}, /api/settings). Frontend: (1) BillDetail renders full invoice on success (Invoice header, items table with GST column showing '0%' for legacy items and '25%' discount rendering correctly, Subtotal/Discount/Total rows, payment card). (2) BillDetail on invalid id (/bills/nonexistent-xyz-999) shows friendly 'Bill load nahi ho paya' UI + Retry button — NO blank screen. (3) BillsList shows 22 bill cards (both legacy TEST_Anil and new TEST_prec/TEST_flat/TEST_PctGst/TEST_100pct all render — legacy compatibility confirmed). (4) Dashboard shows KPI cards with real values (₹2,243.79 revenue), never blank. (5) Nav smoke: /, /inquiries, /customers, /visit, /bills all render non-blank content (450-2313 chars body text). (6) window.focus event does NOT clear the token or redirect to /login — background /auth/me 401-bypass works. (7) ConnectionStatus banner works both ways: offline event → red 'Offline — reconnecting…' banner, online event → green 'Wapas connected' banner (visible in screenshot). (8) ErrorBoundary present in App.js wrapping the router. (9) api.js interceptor verified: 30s timeout, GET-retry-on-network-error with _retryCount<2 + backoff, 401 with _background flag skips redirect. No blank pages observed in any tested flow.

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning on Dashboard mount and DialogContent missing aria-describedby warnings persist — cosmetic, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: api.js retry logic mutates `err.config._retryCount` directly which works but couples to axios internals — acceptable for now.

auth.jsx uses `refresh(background=true)` from the exported context (line 57) — good; but the initial mount call uses refresh(false), so an expired token on cold start still redirects to /login as intended. Confirmed correct behavior.

ConnectionStatus is passive (only listens to browser online/offline events); it will NOT detect API-level failures where the network reports online but backend is unreachable. Consider a lightweight periodic /api/ping heartbeat for stronger UX, though not required by this iteration.
ErrorBoundary.reset() force-reloads the whole app (window.location.reload). Fine but state is lost — acceptable.
BillDetail load() sets error via fmtErr(e). If /api/settings fails silently (catch → {}), settingsSafe fallback handles it — good defensive coding.
server.py still ~860 lines (flagged in iter2) — untouched this iteration, still recommended to split.
seed_data_creation: None new. Leftover TEST_* bills from prior iterations still present (harmless, used for legacy-render regression).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resilience suite validated: no-blank-page guarantees on Dashboard/BillsList/BillDetail with skeleton + error + retry states; focus-refresh 401 bypass keeps user logged in; ConnectionStatus banner triggers on window online/offline events (verified in browser). Regression run cmd: `pytest /app/backend/tests -q`. For UI focus-event test, dispatch `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'))` and confirm localStorage.funland_token is unchanged and url does not become /login. For offline banner test, redefine navigator.onLine and dispatch offline/online events.
rca of the issue: N/A — the user-reported 'blank pages' bug appears fully mitigated by: (a) skeleton loading states replacing null-render, (b) ErrorBoundary catch-all fallback, (c) BillDetail explicit error UI with Retry, (d) null-safe rendering (items ||[], settingsSafe = settings || {}), (e) background 401 bypass preventing unexpected logouts, (f) 30s axios timeout + 2x GET retry. All verified working in preview URL.
